When you walk or bike, those expenses disappear, and over time the savings can add up in a noticeable way.

Walking or biking also builds exercise into your day without requiring extra planning. You do not have to schedule a workout, drive to a gym, or set aside a separate block of time. Walking or biking slows the trip down just enough to make it more connected and enjoyable. For short distances, leaving the car behind is not just a transportation choice; it is a way to spend less, move more, and feel more at home where you live.
